rotation_recommended_because: PYPI_API_TOKEN was pasted in chat history once. R4.5-F audit confirms zero token traces in git-tracked content. Chat exposure is the residual leak channel; rotation eliminates it.
steps: 1. Generate new project-scoped token at https://pypi.org/manage/account/token/ (scope: Project: autodev-ai, was Entire account)
2. Update GitHub repo secret via printf|gh secret set stdin pipe (never -p/--body flag)
3. Revoke OLD token on PyPI (burns the chat-leaked credential)
4. Verify on next tag push (release.yml twine upload uses new token)
safety_constraints: Do NOT paste new token back into chat
Do NOT write token to any file in repo (even .env)
Do NOT use gh secret set --body (token in argv briefly)
blocking_for_release_detail: v0.1.0a2 already published; current token works; rotation is hygiene not blocker. Next release will use whichever token is current at the time.
